name: wails
description: Use when a Go desktop app, webview app, or GUI is built, reviewed, or debugged with Wails — "wails", `wails.json`, a v2 (stable) or v3 (alpha) project, Go-to-frontend bindings, or a native window that must not bundle Chromium. Not for general Go logic (use go), CLIs (use cobra-viper), release packaging and versioning (use go-release), or web frameworks with no Go backend.
